parent_objective: design no-rerun slice diagnosis for targeted containment localization
blocked_by: M2266 finds aggregate M2265 result inconclusive without M2258 slice metrics
supersedes: another training run before slice diagnosis

public_gates: M2267 must design a no-rerun diagnosis over existing M2244 M2253 and M2265 episode rows
M2267 must make M2244 vs M2265 the primary comparison
M2267 must include M2253 as a generic-repair reference
M2267 must include mid_offtrack mild_overshoot clearance-risk and profile-seed axes
M2267 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns aggregate M2265 localization into a no-rerun slice diagnosis design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if required episode rows are missing
stop if design omits mid_offtrack or mild_overshoot axes
stop if design would claim repair success from aggregate outcome alone
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis before implementation if all panels are complete
route to artifact repair if episode rows are incomplete
route to branch synthesis if slice diagnosis cannot answer the repair question
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2266 routes aggregate outcome audit to slice diagnosis

admission_evidence: M2266 blocks aggregate-only repair success claim
allowed_updates: M2267 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2267 designs outcome-slice analysis and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2267; no wrong-history reset-hidden or zero-history intervention is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If slice diagnosis shows no support, synthesize or redesign current-sim route rather than lowering self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds slice-level route evidence rather than another local reward/training search
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether targeted containment repair actually fixes the M2256 failure slice
must_synthesize_if: M2267 cannot define a bounded slice diagnosis
M2267 would recommend another training run before slice evidence
M2267 would claim success from aggregate M2265 counts alone

hypothesis: A no-rerun slice diagnosis can determine whether M2265 restored the M2256 midcourse/mild offtrack failure slices or only improved aggregate counts.
success_criteria: design fixes M2244 M2265 and M2253 episode inputs
design makes M2244 vs M2265 the primary comparison
design includes mid_offtrack mild_overshoot clearance-risk and profile-seed axes
design selects a follow-up synthesis-before-implementation route
no reset rollout measured execution training replay private holdout ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: design treats aggregate M2265 outcome as sufficient
design ranks profiles or selects a winner
design makes finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 self-ID claims

commands.name: design
commands.command: manual design of no-rerun targeted containment failure-slice diagnosis

decision_rule: M2267 passes if it freezes a no-rerun slice diagnosis design and keeps ranking and paper claims blocked.
